about_short_description.short_description: GroundControl is an innovation management software to set up and manage innovation ecosystems.

product.name: GroundControl Innovation Management Software
product.description: A software platform to manage and track corporate innovation ventures using a stage-gate model and innovation accounting metrics.

product.name: NEXT Canvas
product.description: A product-lifecycle framework canvas to test and track progress of business ideas through four validation stages.

product.name: Innovation Accounting
product.description: A system to measure and track innovation performance using key metrics across ventures and portfolios.

product.name: Venture Board Management
product.description: A tool to manage corporate venture investment decisions through stage-based progress tracking and meeting documentation.

product.name: Experiment Management and Templates
product.description: Features to design, assign, and document innovation experiments to validate business model assumptions.

product.name: Innovation Portfolio Management
product.description: A system to visualize and manage multiple startups and innovation projects within a corporate portfolio.
